text.tspan: Annual rate of people affected by all natural disasters excluding extreme
The total number of people affected is the sum of those injured, requiring assistance, and left homeless. Rates are measured
per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.
Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
